Behind him is a wall with a stylized world map and some storage containers. He gestures with his hands while looking at the camera. (2) Close-up shot of a small specialized keyboard with purple, yellow, and white keys. The keys have Chinese text labels. The man's hand enters the frame to point at the keys. (3) The scene shifts to a computer monitor displaying various AI software interfaces, including PPT generation and document summarization. The man is seen in the corner or from the side as he operates the keyboard and points at the screen. (4) Close-up of the keyboard again, focusing on the "Mic" indicator light and specific function keys. (5) The man holds the keyboard up to the camera, smiling and gesturing towards it while speaking directly to the viewer. (6) Return to the initial setup where the man sits at the desk, emphasizing the product's value with hand movements and facial expressions of excitement.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-energy male narrator speaking in Chinese over an upbeat electronic dance music track. The voice is clear and projected, suggesting a studio recording environment. (2) A sharp digital 'whoosh' sound effect triggers as the narration shifts to describing a physical product. Subtle clicking sounds of keyboard keys are heard under the continuous music. (3) During the software demonstration phase, various 'ding' and UI feedback sound effects are layered to emphasize on-screen actions. The narrator's pitch rises with excitement when demonstrating AI capabilities. (4) The final segment features a strong rhythmic beat in the BGM as the narrator delivers a pricing comparison. The audio concludes with a definitive vocal punch and a quick fade out of the music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem (High AI Costs) -> Solution (Meekee AI Keyboard) -> Feature Demonstration -> Value Proposition -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To persuade viewers to purchase the Meekee AI keyboard by demonstrating its ease of use for various AI-driven tasks and emphasizing its cost-effectiveness compared to monthly software subscriptions.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration and price comparison of the branded product Meekee AI Keyboard.
